V114 versus Prevnar 13: the four solicited injection-site symptoms

In participants randomised to the 15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine V114 or to the 13-valent comparator Prevnar 13, how does the risk of each solicited injection-site symptom compare?

In this section: Registration and administrative information (PROSPERO field set) · What this object claims to contain

What this object claims to contain

This reports every solicited injection-site symptom these trials post. Not every trial posts every symptom, and each outcome names the trials that contribute to it. It is a local tolerability review and covers neither immunogenicity nor protection against pneumococcal disease.

Not held in this object. No search record is held in this object. The included set was reconciled against published syntheses rather than produced by a database search, so no query, date or yield can be shown. Treat the included set as a convenience sample, not a systematic one.
Not held in this object. No screening log is recorded for this review. The included set was reconciled against published syntheses rather than screened from a search, so no records-identified, excluded-with-reason or dual-screening counts exist.

TSA boundaries depend entirely on a target information size that must be pre-specified. This review's protocol registers none, so any boundary drawn here would be a parameter chosen after seeing the data -- which is the practice TSA exists to protect against.

This is recorded as a declared departure under Cochrane Handbook §III.3.4.1: the review reports a pooled estimate for which no certainty assessment was made. Rating it here would require two assessors and an adjudicator, and a rating produced by neither is not a GRADE assessment whatever letter it carries.
  2. Read this beside `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the same quantity. It records nothing about what that quantity was measured against -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

In participants randomised to the 15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine V114 or to the 13-valent comparator Prevnar 13, how does the risk of each solicited injection-site symptom compare?2

Introduction

1Background. This review asks: In participants randomised to the 15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine V114 or to the 13-valent comparator Prevnar 13, how does the risk of each solicited injection-site symptom compare? It examines 7 randomised trials and does not pool them. The outcomes sought are Injection-site pain or tenderness; Injection-site swelling; Injection-site erythema or redness; Injection-site induration or hard lump.

Results

Injection-site pain or tenderness. These 7 trials are not pooled, and the reason is stated rather than the outcome being quietly omitted: Not one of the seven trials registers this symptom as an outcome measure. Each registers a single solicited injection-site endpoint -- 'Percentage of Participants With a Solicited Injection-site Adverse Event' or its close variant -- and the individual symptoms appear only as classes inside that measure's posted results. So the quantity is registry-sourced and real, but the four outcomes this page separates were never separated by the trials: they are components of one registered composite, reported alongside each other and never pre-specified as endpoints in their own right. A synthesis of them carries no pre-specification and cannot be protected against selective reporting by the registrations, because the registrations do not name them. Second, independent reason -- the observation windows do not match: two trials solicit over five days and five over fourteen. A fourteen-day window will record symptoms a five-day window cannot, so the same symptom is not the same measurement across these trials. Registered windows, verbatim: Up to 14 days after vaccination (NCT02547649); Up to 5 days after Vaccination 1 (NCT03547167); Up to Day 5 postvaccination (NCT03950622); Up to ~14 days after each vaccination (NCT03620162); Up to Day 14 after each study vaccination (NCT03692871); Day 1 to Day 14 post each vaccination (NCT03848065); Through 14 Days after Vaccination 1 (NCT03921424). No estimate was ever displayed for these outcomes and none is created here; this records why the object's existing poolable=False is correct, which it previously asserted with no reason recorded.1
